edition.caveat: Inland Revenue Department consolidation, not a statutory copy. Its cover reads: “This consolidated text of the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act No 12 of 2006 incorporates the amendment made to that Act by the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act No.10 of 2008. Please note, however, that this consolidated text cannot be regarded as a statutory copy of the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act No 12 of 2006. It is prepared for the purpose of convenient reference only.”
edition.pages_used: pp. 4-9 of 26 (the Act); pp. 1-3 cover and table of sections; pp. 10-26 reproduce ten Gazette Extraordinary notifications (Orders under the Stamp Duty Act, No. 43 of 1982 and under this Act) which are not part of the Act and are not in this tree

quality_flags.detail: scripts/parse_consolidated_pdf.py --source-id SRC068 produced 32 sections from this PDF: marginal notes were spliced into body text, sections 4-5 and 9-16 were mangled or lost, and the appended Gazette pages (pp. 10-26) were read as sections. The IRD layout (section number in a left gutter, wide body, note in a right column, no chain header) is not the two-column Government Printer layout that parser expects. The tree here was assembled by hand instead; see provenance.

pp. 10-26 of the IRD PDF reproduce Gazette Extraordinary Nos. 1439/1, 1439/2, 1439/3, 1441/17, 1441/18, 1465/19, 1465/20, 1478/7, 1530/13 and 1546/7 (rate and exemption Orders). They are subsidiary legislation, not part of Act No. 12 of 2006, and are deliberately excluded.

Printed errors are kept as printed: “PTOVIDE” in the long title; “the date of it publication” in 3(3); “holder ;” with a space before the semicolon in 6(d); “may be :” in 9; the missing opening quotation mark before Commissioner – General in the section 14 definition. The as-enacted print has “; or ;” at the end of 3(1)(a); the IRD consolidation prints “; or” and that is what the tree carries.

editorial_notes: Section 8 is carried twice in the IRD print: the repealed text (p.6, margin note “Applicable up to 31.12.2007 Repealed $ 3, 10 of 2008 w. e .f. 01.01.2008”) followed by the substituted text (pp. 6-7, margin note “$ 3, 10 of 2008 w.e.f.01.01.2008”). The tree carries the substituted section as the current text and the repealed section under text_before_amendment.
The IRD table of sections prints “CHAPTER I”; the body prints “CHAPTER 1”. The body form is used.
Section 14 prints the definitions of “Assessor” and “Commissioner – General” as a single entry; the tree carries one definition node per term with the shared printed entry as the text of both.

The Act's section 13 does not amend the text of the Stamp Duty Act, No. 43 of 1982; it makes that Act's imposition and exemption provisions inoperative so far as inconsistent with this Act. Section 15 repeals Part III (sections 15 to 18) of the Finance Act, No. 11 of 2002, which is not held.
checked_against: data/legal-sources/library/statutes/12-2006-stamp-duty-special-provisions-act.pdf pp. 4-9 (Inland Revenue Department consolidation, text layer, rendered with pdftotext -layout from PowerShell); data/legal-sources/library/amendments/incoming/12-2006-stamp-duty-act-amendment.pdf (Government Printer, as enacted); data/legal-sources/library/amendments/html/12-2006-stamp-duty-special-provisions.html (LankaLaw, as enacted, parsed with build_canonical_statutes.parse for the skeleton); data/legal-sources/library/amendments/10-2008-stamp-duty-special-provisions-amendment-act.pdf (Government Printer text of the amending Act)

provenance.against: IRD consolidated PDF pp. 4-9 read line by line; every node's wording word-matched against that text (scripts/check_parse_coverage.py --tree --text on pp. 4-9, plus a reverse check that no tree word is absent from the print); structure and headings taken from the LankaLaw HTML skeleton and confirmed against the Government Printer as-enacted PDF; the Act No. 10 of 2008 operations confirmed against that Act's own Government Printer text
provenance.what_changed: The automated parse (parse_consolidated_pdf.py, 32 sections) was discarded in full. The tree was rebuilt: 16 sections in 3 chapters with the marginal notes as headings; subsections, paragraphs, provisos, closing text, the section 7(2) certificate form and two definitions as typed nodes; the two Act No. 10 of 2008 operations (section 6 paragraph (d) substituted and (dd)/(ddd) inserted; section 8 repealed and replaced) recorded as amendment_events with the pre-amendment wording under text_before_amendment; the Gazette pages excluded; edition.publisher set to Inland Revenue Department with its non-statutory caveat quoted; certification and commencement dates put in ISO form with the printed wording kept.

children.raw_text: Stamp duty payable on any specified instrument relating to a mortgage or lease of any immovable property may be paid, prior to, or at the time of, the execution of the specified instrument, to a prescribed bank. Where however, the stamp duty cannot be so paid due to reasons beyond the control of the person by whom the stamp duty is payable, the stamp duty shall be paid to the prescribed bank within seven days from the date of such execution. The bank shall thereupon issue a certificate in the prescribed form certifying that the stamp duty has been duly paid and such certificate shall be affixed to the instrument so executed.

The bank shall thereupon issue a certificate in the prescribed form certifying that the stamp duty has been duly paid and such certificate shall be affixed to the instrument so executed.

children.raw_text: Any person executing a specified instrument shall at the time of the execution of such specified instrument which is not stamped with an impressed stamp, cancel the stamps thereon by writing or marking in ink on or across each stamp, his name or initials, thereby preventing the stamp from being used again. Further, where such specified instrument bears an adhesive stamp of the value of fifty rupees or more, such stamp shall be cancelled by the person executing a specified instrument by perforating the same by either cutting or pricking the stamp with a suitable instrument.

children.heading: Procedure where document is insufficiently stamped.
children.raw_text: Where an Assessor is of the opinion that an instrument liable to stamp duty has not been duly stamped, he shall assess the value of the stamp duty payable in respect of such instrument, by the person liable to pay such duty and forward a Notice to such person requiring him to pay the amount due thereon, within the time specified in the Notice.
